stories.h: Netanyahu said readying offer to serve second in rotation
stories.s: Channel 13 reported Netanyahu may offer Eisenkot the first turn as PM, sent through unofficial channels per Kan. Eisenkot is skeptical, and Bennett may oppose any Eisenkot government formed before Likud talks are exhausted.

stories.h: IDF on high alert for possible Iranian surprise attack
stories.s: Citing Walla, the Post reports the military, especially the air force, is on heightened readiness and coordinating closely with US Central Command, with intelligence upgrading early warning to allow a preemptive strike if needed.

stories.h: Ra'am's Abbas set to call Hamas a terror group
stories.s: Mansour Abbas is to make the declaration in a Saturday-night Channel 12 interview, removing a condition Eisenkot set for partners. Ra'am reportedly promises coalition discipline; Netanyahu's allies dismiss it as deception.

stories.h: Israeli strike kills two MSF guards at Gaza clinic
stories.s: Doctors Without Borders said two guards were killed in a direct hit at its Gaza clinic, bringing its staff death toll there to 17. The IDF says the men were Hamas fighters and denies targeting medical facilities.

coming.h: Bennett and Eisenkot to meet on coalition
coming.s: The meeting was put off from Thursday amid disputes over Haredi conscription; Bennett, whose party has no deal yet, still prefers a unity government with Likud.

coming.h: Eisenkot's mandate to form government expires
coming.s: Eisenkot says he will form a government before his mandate runs out. Herzog can extend it by up to 14 days. If that fails, another MK gets 28 days before a new election becomes likely.
